title: 1246 Delete Platform Type
body:
Fixes #1246 

Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci , please have a look on the demo below:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/151181607-0b3e975c-b69b-43d8-8d48-b0ef2788ce14.mov

comments_data.body: Thanks @lebaphi - but I'm afraid we need confirmation on delete. The Game Designer may have put a lot of effort into a designing a platform-type, so we don't want to lose that investment of time by accident.
Looks excellent @lebaphi. As for the confirmation, I suppose a simple pop-up asking "Are you sure you want to permanently delete this asset?" would do.
Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci plz take a 👀
> Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci plz take a eyes > > Excellent! Thanks @lebaphi! Can you just put the delete button on the right, and the cancel button on the left please?

Update: The button doesn't seem to be working for me.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/151559298-439d7bb3-9b0c-418e-8126-fdd1f6d1746a.mp4
Hi @ShendMikullovci, I think you should `Save` the platform first then you can `Delete` it 😄

> Hi @ShendMikullovci, I think you should `Save` the platform first then you can `Delete` it smile

My bad. All good.

It does seem a problem that a newly created platform-type can't be deleted.

It's not intuitive that a player must save the item before deleting it.  I guess the newly created platform-type is inconsistent in some way.  @lebaphi - could you investigate the issue please?

 If a Game Designer accidentally creates two rather than one, he can't delete either of them until they have been saved.  Actually -  if multiple ones are created, i _think_ that deleting one deletes all of them.  
 
 ![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/66daef3ad7f1899828f8bab4445e4441.gif)

> It does seem a problem that a newly created platform-type can't be deleted.
> 
> It's not intuitive that a player must save the item before deleting it. I guess the newly created platform-type is inconsistent in some way. @lebaphi - could you investigate the issue please?
> 
> If a Game Designer accidentally creates two rather than one, he can't delete either of them until they have been saved. Actually - if multiple ones are created, i _think_ that deleting one deletes all of them.
> 
> ![screencast](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/478507df66651891a2f781904b8d69f1c00f4c6e0ed2089b5e4c07693a9dcbde/68747470733a2f2f692e6779617a6f2e636f6d2f36366461656633616437663138393938323866386261623434343565343434312e676966)

While I agree it would be easier to have the platform saved automatically, we could also have a pop-up asking whether the user is sure they want to delete, similar to other features we introduced it to.

issues.title: Can't delete Platform from the Admin Page
issues.body:
There's no delete button once a user creates a platform on the admin page.
![Can't delete platform](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/145621384-db746e1f-af2c-496f-8a69-809ffcc99499.png)

I would assume it's important to be able to delete a platform from the game if necessary.

I suggest we stick to feature we use the channel delete feature (next to the channel title there's a delete button next to the duplicate button): 
![Channel Delete Feature](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/145621693-63db252f-a998-4ff1-9e80-bdf8289d7e78.png)

Let me know what you all think.
